login_intro: Sign in to access your domain and network tools.
login_limited: Too many attempts. Try again in five minutes.
execution_origin: All checks run from this server.
privacy: Inputs and results live in temporary memory and disappear on restart.
overview_desc: From domains to network diagnostics. Choose a tool to begin.
domain_batch_desc: Authoritative RDAP and WHOIS checks, with honest availability signals.
dns_desc: Query DNS records with dig-style output. Full DNSSEC validation is not performed.
ping_desc: Real ICMP from the server to your target. Up to 10 packets.
ip_desc: Inspect addresses, calculate networks, query reverse DNS and IP allocation.
http_desc: Inspect HTTP responses and TLS certificates through validated connections.
resources_desc: Official reference data updates only when you request it.
about_desc: An open-source toolbox for a clearer view of domains and networks.
paste_help: One domain per line, without a URL, port or path. Lines starting with # are ignored.
file_help: UTF-8 · up to 1 MiB · 1,000 unique domains
empty_hint: Enter a target and run a check to see live results.
clear_help: Clears the view only. The job and export remain intact.
availability_notice: “Likely available” means no registration record was found. Purchase eligibility and price are not guaranteed. Missing DNS does not imply availability.
about_body: NetNama runs on Flask without a database. This release uses one process and stores no permanent history. Results expire after 15 minutes. RDAP and WHOIS describe registration, not guaranteed purchase availability. IP allocations do not establish device location.
ir_notice: For .ir, matching registered records and explicit NIC.IR no-match responses are recognized. Ambiguous responses remain unknown; no record is not a purchase guarantee.
truncated: Output was truncated at the size limit.
csrf_error: Form token expired or invalid. Reload the page.
invalid_file: Only UTF-8 TXT files are accepted.
unknown_tld: Suffix is not in the IANA list.
invalid_url: Use an http/https URL without credentials on port 80 or 443.
not_found: Job not found or access denied.
blocked_resolver: Custom resolvers are not allowed in public mode.
private_warning: Private target access is enabled. Requests originate on the server network.
reason_subdomain: This is a subdomain. Review the suggested registrable domain.
reason_rdap_not_found: Validated authoritative response: no record found.
reason_rdap_mismatch: Response object or target does not match.
reason_whois_unverified_no_match: WHOIS wording is not verified for availability.
reason_blocked_target: Non-public target blocked by network policy.
reason_ping_binary_missing: Ping executable is not installed on this server.
reason_ping_no_reply: No confirmed ICMP reply; this does not prove the host is down.
reason_ip_allocation: IP allocation information, not device location.
reason_dns_noerror: DNS returned NOERROR; answer may be empty.
reason_unknown_tld: Suffix is not in the IANA list.
reason_invalid_url: Use an http/https URL without credentials on port 80 or 443.
reason_fallback: The check was inconclusive. See the report for technical details.
reason_whois_no_match: Explicit NIC.IR no-match; purchase availability is not guaranteed.
